5056141065595.sourceDescription:
Bring a warm festive touch to your home with this 35cm battery operated LED twig hanging heart decoration in red. Designed as a decorative heart shape wreath, it is ideal for displaying on a front door, above a fireplace, or as a seasonal centrepiece on a table. The pre-lit design adds instant seasonal charm, while the mix of twig and PVC materials creates a lightweight decoration that is easy to hang and enjoy throughout the festive period. Featuring warm white LED lights alongside red baubles, berries, stars, green foliage and rustic pine cones, this hanging heart adds texture, colour and a traditional Christmas feel to your décor. It is battery operated and requires 2 x AA batteries, which are not included, making it simple to place wherever you want a festive glow without needing a mains connection. With a foldable design for easier storage, this decoration can be packed away and reused for future seasonal displays. Its heart-shaped form offers a distinctive alternative to traditional wreaths and works well in indoor spaces where you want to create a welcoming holiday atmosphere. Whether used alone or matched with other decorations from the same range, it is a versatile choice for Christmas styling, seasonal displays and special occasions. The combination of pre-strung lights and decorative detailing helps create a finished look with minimal effort, making it a practical and attractive addition to your festive home décor.

Decorated with red baubles, berries, stars, green foliage and rustic pine cones for a festive finish

Style around the occasion

Give the detail room to show

Plan the display

8941467526295.sourceDescription:
You will receive 6 dark green velvet cabinet door bows, each with a centre bow of about 9.8 x 7 in (25 x 18 cm). The ribbon measures about 3.28 ft (1 m) per tail, and with two tails each bow gives a total length of about 6.56 ft (2 m), which is enough to dress a run of kitchen cupboard doors or a mix of doors and drawers.

The bows are made from soft velvet fabric with a sealed lock edge finish, so the cut edges stay neat and the shape holds its fullness. A hidden steel wire inside each bow keeps it standing upright instead of flopping forward against the door. Hook and loop fasteners on the back let you press the bow into place and lift it off again without leaving marks, and you can gather the ribbon to the size that suits your cabinet.

Tie or stick them to kitchen cabinets, wardrobe doors, windows, fireplaces, stair rails and the Christmas tree, indoors or in a sheltered spot outside. They also suit weddings, banquets and birthday parties, and can be left up as everyday decoration once the season is over.

Velvet creases easily and the ribbons are folded for transit, so a bow may arrive with soft wrinkles. A quick press with an iron on a low setting removes them without affecting the shape, and slight differences in shade between screens are normal. Keep the ribbons out of reach of young children because of the winding risk.

5056214068195.sourceDescription:
Brighten up your Christmas display with this stunning InLit Holly Ball. Designed for maximum festive impact with minimum effort, this battery-powered decoration is ideal for hanging by your door, along a porch, or even indoors. It's filled with realistic faux holly leaves and laced with 20 warm white LEDs for a gentle, welcoming glow.

Insert two AA batteries (not included) and it's ready to go. There's a built-in timer too, so the lights switch on for 4 hours and off for 20 automatically, no need to remember a thing.

This decorative topiary ball is surprisingly versatile. Use it outdoors to dress up your front step or garden arch, or indoors in hallways, conservatories, or even as a centrepiece. Lightweight and easy to hang, it brings soft light and seasonal joy wherever it goes.

When the season’s over, it packs away neatly and is ready to go again next Christmas.
FESTIVE HIGHLIGHT: This battery-powered holly ball is the quick and easy way to create festive atmosphere indoors or outdoors. It glows with 20 warm white LEDs among realistic faux holly leaves.
TIMER FUNCTION INCLUDED: A built-in 4-hour on/20-hour off timer means the lights come on automatically at the same time each day, saving effort and battery life.
INSTANT WINTER STYLE: Lightweight and easy to hang, this glowing holly topiary ball looks fabulous on porches, hooks, trees, or even as an indoor centrepiece.
DETAILS: Supplied as an artificial holly ball with 20 warm white LEDs and integrated timer. Requires 2 x AA batteries (not included). Ready to hang and enjoy.
ABOUT US: At YouGarden, we believe that gardening is for everyone. Based in rural Lincolnshire we have our own 11 acre nursery, meaning that we are in close contact with our plants, so that we can guarantee our plants will thrive because we've grown them ourselves. We also source product locally, nationally and internationally to ensure we give our customers the best range, highest quality and greatest value for money. All our products will arrive in nursery fresh condition.

The decorative oval bauble shape adds interest to traditional holiday arrangements, making it easy to refresh your tree, mantel display or other festive scenes with coordinated shine.

Crafted for hanging display, these decorations include an attached loop for simple placement on branches and decorative settings. The lightweight design makes them practical for use across a range of indoor Christmas styling ideas, while the shimmering sequin surface helps deliver a polished finish that suits classic, luxury or fairy-tale inspired themes. Whether you are updating a family tree, creating a coordinated seasonal scheme or adding extra detail to a special display, this bauble set offers an elegant and versatile choice.

The set is also suitable for use in other decorative locations where a festive touch is wanted, such as windows, porches, doors and balconies, subject to suitable conditions. Matches Various Styles: Whether your home is minimalist, traditional, or bohemian, the soft texture and festive aesthetic of the skirt fit right in—no need to overhaul existing decor.

5058194864095.sourceDescription:
Christmas Wreath
It adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Fabric. Quantity: 1 set.
Festive fabric wreath designed to add a practical decorative detail to your Christmas display.
Creates a focal point for your arrangement, allowing space around it to highlight its outline and details.
Single set includes one festive door decoration, ready to coordinate with existing room colour and texture accents.
Flexible finishing touch that can be easily moved or adjusted within its intended setting to refresh the look.
Comes with 1 x Christmas Wreath

5096042276195.baseName: LED Christmas wreath - Christmas wreath with lights - 80 LEDs and 126 branches, battery powered for a hallway or mantel - 80 cm
5096042276195.variantName: LED Christmas wreath - Christmas wreath with lights - 80 LEDs and 126 branches, battery powered for a hallway or mantel - 80 cm
5096042276195.sourceDescription:
The 80 cm span and 126 PVC branches give this wreath a generous outline on a wide door or wall. Eighty battery-operated LEDs run through the greenery, and the timer lets you set a regular lighting period.

The lighting gives this wreath two different uses in the same spot. In natural daylight the decorative details provide the colour and texture. Once the lights are switched on, the outline is still visible from the far end of a hall. Allow access to the battery compartment when arranging the display. Positioning it where you can change the cells without disturbing the front of the decoration makes a difference if you leave it up throughout the season.

Choose the start of the lighting period with the room's usual evening routine in mind. It is worth checking the controls while the wreath is still within reach, before moving it to its final position. The centre opening lets the background play a part in the design.

To carry the colours into the rest of the room, pick out one detail from the wreath and repeat it in wrapping ribbon, a table runner or decorations on the tree. Even a single matching accent can bring two separate displays together. Think about access to the controls before choosing the final position. Leave enough room to reach the switch comfortably while keeping the front of the arrangement clear, especially if you plan to change the lighting during the evening.

If you already have a busy Christmas tree, give the wreath a space of its own. A quiet patch of wall brings the outline into focus and gives visitors a chance to see the individual details as they pass. For a calm scheme, carry one colour from the decoration into a nearby ornament and leave the space immediately around the wreath clear. The display then has a daytime focal point as well as an illuminated outline in the evening.
80 cm diameter wreath featuring 126 PVC branches for a full, festive appearance.
Integrated timer function allows you to set automatic lighting periods for convenience.
Powered by batteries for flexible placement on hallways, mantels, or doors without cords.
Comprises 80 LED lights woven through greenery to create a warm, illuminated outline.

5052532163895.sourceDescription:
Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Fabric. Quantity: 1 set.
Festive Father Christmas motif adds a recognisable seasonal character to your home decor.
Versatile fabric wreath designed as a practical decorative detail for doors or walls.
Single set quantity allows for easy placement and flexible arrangement in any display.
Simple design helps create a consistent festive theme when paired with other decorations.
Comes with 1 x Christmas Wreath

VERSATILE HOME DECORATION: Ideal for refreshing your home throughout the year, whether you're looking for summer, autumn, winter or festive Christmas decorations.

With its classic Christmas-tree shape and naturally dense growth, a pot-grown Fraser Fir makes a traditional choice for the festive season while offering something extra beyond December. The rich green foliage forms neat layers of branches that are easy to decorate, while the short, soft needles and good needle retention help it remain an attractive feature throughout the celebrations. This real Christmas tree has also been grown in a pot from the outset, rather than being lifted from the ground and transferred into a container before sale.
CLASSIC CHRISTMAS CHARACTER: Naturally conical and densely branched, Fraser Fir has the traditional Christmas-tree shape many people look for, with rich green foliage that creates a full appearance without needing excessive decoration. The branches provide plenty of room for lights, baubles, and other festive favourites.
WHY CHOOSE POT-GROWN CHRISTMAS TREES?: This tree has been grown in its pot from the beginning, rather than being lifted from the ground and transferred into a container shortly before sale. Its roots have had time to develop within the pot as the tree has grown, without the disturbance of being dug up and moved. This makes it better suited to continuing its growth after Christmas, with a more established root system already growing in the pot. Unlike potted Christmas trees that have only recently been transferred from the ground, it can be kept outdoors and grown on after the festive season.
SOFT NEEDLES, LASTING DISPLAY: Fraser Fir has relatively soft needles that are pleasant to handle when decorating, while its needle retention helps it maintain a full appearance throughout the festive period. The foliage also releases a fresh, characteristic fir fragrance, adding another familiar part of the real Christmas tree experience.
FROM CHRISTMAS TREE TO GARDEN TREE: Once Christmas is over, move your real tree back outdoors and continue caring for it as it grows. Fraser Firs are excellent evergreen trees for garden, bringing year-round foliage and structure rather than having its role end when the decorations come down.
ENJOY IT AGAIN IN YEARS TO COME: Caring for a pot-grown tree between Christmases gives it the opportunity to return to your home for future celebrations. Keep it growing outdoors during the rest of the year, and this potted real Christmas tree can become a Christmas tradition that grows with you, rather than a tree bought and replaced each season.
Please Note: Our pot grown trees are measured from the base of the pot to the tip of the tree.

5056709903895.sourceDescription:
EVRE Canada Spruce is our premium 8ft (240 cm) unlit artificial Christmas tree, styled on a Canadian spruce with 1700 pine-needle tips and a heavyweight 14.3 kg build for a full, natural silhouette that stands solid once decorated. Hinged branches drop into place as the three sections slot together, and it suits rooms with high ceilings, open-plan lounges, conservatories and commercial spaces. It comes apart after Christmas to store and use again year after year.
Premium 8ft (240 cm) Canada Spruce with 1700 pine-needle tips for dense, natural-looking branches with plenty of room for decorations.
Heavyweight 14.3 kg build with a foldable metal stand (60 x 60 x 32 cm) and protective floor caps, so it stands steady once fully decorated.
Quick to put up: hinged branches drop into place as you slot the three sections together. Unlit, so you choose your own lights and decorations.
Approximate size: 240 cm high and 138 cm wide at the base. Suits rooms with high ceilings, open-plan lounges, conservatories and commercial spaces.
Shaping: peel back each branch and spread the tips from the inside out. Allow up to 30 minutes for the fullest finish.
Comes apart for storage at the end of the season and can be reused year after year.
Safety: keep away from fires, heaters and naked flames, use lights designed for Christmas trees, and supervise children and pets near the tree.
Available in 4ft 5ft 6ft 7ft 8ft and 9ft
Guarantee - 2 years
